gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: The leaflet gives a clear ___ (EXPLAIN) of the rules.
Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.

gaps.explanation: 'The wind strengthened' — the verb from STRONG.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.
'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
